notes:
E-Sys error messages now say what they mean and what to do, right in E-Sys's own message window.
New: Flashing > Last job report shows E-Sys's last job in plain words: every module, the step it stopped at and why. It opens by itself when a flash or FSC job does not finish.
The fault scan's "What does a code mean?" also explains E-Sys's message codes, like C012.
